run_adversarial_qa_preprocessing: run the adversarial QA dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data splits
create_adversarialqa_dataset_instance: create an AdversarialQA dataset instance with hf_identifier and text-to-text task type
load_adversarial_qa_dataset: load the adversarial_qa dataset from HuggingFace using the adversarialQA configuration
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of question-context and answer tuples
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits for the AdversarialQA dataset with a given seed
